title: Rausser College of Natural Resources requirements

requirements.title: Reading & Composition A
requirements.notes: First half of R&C (an R1A or R4A course), or an AP/IB exam score. Complete by the end of your first year.

requirements.title: Reading & Composition B
requirements.notes: Second half of R&C (an R1B or R4B course). Complete by the end of your second year.

requirements.title: Quantitative Reasoning

rules.text: Satisfied by exam (SAT Math 620+, ACT Math 28+, AP Calculus AB/BC 3+, AP Statistics 3+, or IB Math)

requirements.notes: Exam scores or one approved course in math, statistics, computer science, or logic, with a C- or better.

requirements.title: Foreign Language

rules.text: Satisfied in high school (three years of one language with C- or better) or by AP/SAT II exam

requirements.notes: Required for some CNR majors (e.g. Society & Environment, Environmental Economics & Policy). Check your major.

requirements.title: Breadth: Arts & Literature
requirements.notes: One course in each of five humanities/social-science areas; biological and physical science are covered by major requirements.

requirements.title: Breadth: Historical Studies
requirements.notes: One course in each of five humanities/social-science areas; biological and physical science are covered by major requirements.

requirements.title: Breadth: International Studies
requirements.notes: One course in each of five humanities/social-science areas; biological and physical science are covered by major requirements.

requirements.title: Breadth: Philosophy & Values
requirements.notes: One course in each of five humanities/social-science areas; biological and physical science are covered by major requirements.

requirements.title: Breadth: Social & Behavioral Sciences
requirements.notes: One course in each of five humanities/social-science areas; biological and physical science are covered by major requirements.

requirements.title: 36 upper-division units
requirements.notes: Courses numbered 100-199. Up to 6 units of 300-level courses may count in some colleges.

requirements.title: Senior residence

rule.text: Senior residence: after reaching 90 units, complete at least 24 of your remaining units over two semesters in residence in your college

requirements.notes: Exceptions for UCEAP, UCDC, and other approved programs.
